items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: His son can grow, San Bernard. What's his son's name? He named after his daddy, Vic Dispenza.

ctx.x: Vic Dispenza. I don't know him.
What's his son's name? His son can grow, San Bernard. What's his son's name? He named after his daddy, Vic Dispenza. He must be around about 24, 25 years old now, that boy.
He ought to know Lucci, because Lucci used to work with Red Allen.
